Country	Country
State	State
Site.Name	Site name
LiDAR.Acquisition	LiDAR acquisition
Year	Year of LiDAR acquisition
UTM.Zone	UTM zone
Sampled.Area_km2	Sampled area (in km2)
Mean.TCH_m	Mean top-of-canopy height at 100m resolution (in m)
Range.TCH_m	Range of top-of-canopy height at 100m resolution (in m)
Mean.AGB_Mg/ha	Mean predicted aboveground biomass at 100m resolution (in Mg/ha)
Range.AGB_Mg/ha	Range predicted aboveground biomass at 100m resolution (in Mg/ha)
Mean.CV_unitless	Mean coefficient of variation at 100m resolution (unitless)
Range.CV_unitless	Range of coefficient of variation at 100m resolution (unitless)
N.Pixel	Number of 100m-resolution pixels with aboveground biomass prediction (and associated uncertainty)
